source.title: Enchanting: Has anyone disenchanted a purple item and received a blue reagent before?
source.author: Ilmoran-29156

quote: Out of six items passed to me yesterday, two of them yielded 0 resonant crystals
notes: Original firsthand six raid-drop disenchant operations on Jan 3 2023: exactly two produced zero Resonant Crystals; by subtraction four produced at least one, assuming the comment's 'two' exhausts the six. Positive material unit quantities and per-cast stack sizes were NOT stated; do not turn four hits into four units or claim a full 0/1/2+ histogram. Source only identifies raid drops item level 389+, not their individual item IDs, enchant eligibility or equipment categories. 'Maxed out disenchanting' is the author's statement, not a numeric skill value. Separate at-least-dozen weapon disenchants/4 crystals in same comment may overlap these six and are deliberately NOT entered as an independent cohort.
inputName: Six unnamed Dragonflight raid drops (item level 389+)
